html

html Components
  • ImageDrawing
  • ImageUrl Where an image's pixels come from, each an `<img>` in the image's frame: a URL the browser fetches, which is what a `file:` asset's path is too, or a drawing painted in the page and handed over as a data URL.
  • Page A page of a stack, as this platform serves one: a document of its own on a static site and a route in route mode, written as the whole window with every other page pruned.
  • Stack A stack of pages, which a document never shows whole: each page is written out as the window with the stack standing for that page alone.
  • Window A window is a surface: html writes its document from the first that no `if` over state and no `for` can take away, which is the page, and shows every other as a `<dialog>` in it, without a backdrop as a desktop window is.
  • draw
  • drawSource The primitive a `canvasImage` paints its source through.
  • element The element every tag resolves to.
  • flow The two elements a flow is built from.
  • inline
  • platform The `html` node of a build directive: `output { none { html() } }`.
    • Types
  • ClickEvent A click as `@click` hands it: the element it landed on, and the one the handler hearing it was attached to.
  • Declaration One declaration of an element's inline CSS.
  • DrawContext --- Drawing --- A canvas draws through a CanvasRenderingContext2D, and its methods are the drawing vocabulary.
  • DrawEvent The primitive an override paints through: `@draw` is the target calling in with the context, and the handler body is what the draw function emits.
  • Element An element a click went through, as far as a card asks of it.
  • Event The browser's Event, as an element's handler is handed it.
  • KeyEvent A key pressed while an element has the focus, as `@keydown` hands it: the key's name as the DOM spells it -- "Enter", " " for the space bar -- and the phase it is heard in, 2 when the element the listener is on has the focus itself and 3 when it bubbled up from something inside it.
  • SourceEvent What a `drawSource` paints a fetched or shipped image with: the context, and the URL its source names.
  • Target The element an event was dispatched to, as far as a control reports its state through it: the text of an input, a textarea or a select, and whether a checkbox is checked.
    • Functions
  • alignmentOf
  • backend Force v to run server-side (back-end).
  • boxSide One side of a margin or a padding, written where the box says more than its whole.
  • boxWhole A margin's or a padding's shorthand, written where the box says only its whole: each call here is one the build makes once, as a statement may not make the same one twice and stay a single expression the fold splices.
  • clearInterval
  • colorOf
  • css The declarations a Style writes, a wider one ahead of a narrower one that overrides it: a border shorthand ahead of its width, style and color, and those ahead of one side's.
  • cssColor `rgba(...)` as the DOM spells it.
  • cssLength A length in the one unit it carries, or a calc() summing those it does.
  • directionOf
  • displayOf
  • drawImage The page's own image shim, which carries the decode cache and the wait for a source that has not arrived yet.
  • frontend Force v to run client-side (front-end).
  • justificationOf
  • lengthOf
  • lineOf A border its Style gives a width and no line is drawn solid, as every other target draws one, where CSS's default is none.
  • listStyleOf
  • overflowOf
  • paintStyle Fill and stroke are gated on alpha, which every other backend does and this one did not: the old translation tested the color *object* for truthiness, and a JS object is always truthy, so a fill-only shape also painted an invisible stroke (#225).
  • plus
  • positionOf
  • roleTag The element a flow's role names.
  • serve Serves dir over HTTP at listen, ":0" when empty, printing the address, until the process is stopped.
  • setInterval --- The timer --- The web already schedules, so this platform needs no timer primitive: the setInterval/clearInterval pair is a lifetime with a thing to release, which is what `effect` brackets.
  • side One side of a margin or a padding: the first of its own field, its axis's and the whole box's that is set.
  • slantOf
  • term
  • textAlignOf
  • weightOf
  • whiteSpaceOf
  • whole Whether a box's margin or padding is its whole alone, written as the shorthand rather than a side at a time.
    • Constants
  • controls What takes a click for itself: a card hears none that landed in one.
  • unstyled What a Style may say that a page does not answer: nothing, since each field is a CSS property or the shorthand of one.
